messages.text:
Created the coordinated reallocation memo.

For MAG-03/04/06, it proposes ECal at 1.30–1.66 m and barrel HCal at 1.76–4.20 m, retaining tracker, axial boundaries, outer coil and muon hosts. Tracker and calorimeter engineers agree; the muon engineer conditionally concurs.

Alternatives, geometric checks and unresolved material/field consequences are explicit. No baseline or production changes.

Dashboard validation, 35 session records and whitespace checks passed.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
